description: Read-only crypto threshold prediction hedge analysis using a $1 Black-Scholes digital model and public Hyperliquid data. Returns estimated delta, opposite perp size rounded to venue precision, signed funding costs and +/-2%/5% sensitivities with source/asOf. No order artifacts. Supply annualized impliedVol or use a labelled closed-hourly realized-volatility proxy; unavailable inputs stay unknown.

asset.description: Crypto symbol matching the main Hyperliquid perp, e.g. BTC, ETH or SOL.

contracts.description: Held $1-payout contract count; mutually exclusive with usdNotional.

entryPrice.description: Entry price of the held YES or NO side.

impliedVol.description: Annualized decimal volatility (0.6 means 60%). Omit for a realized-volatility estimate from public hourly candles.

usdNotional.description: Entry cost in USD, converted to contracts by dividing by entryPrice.

name: prediction_hedge
